metadata.description: AI-generated motivational quotes based on posture performance

quotes.quote:
Good job on maintaining good posture, Akshat! Here's a motivational quote to keep you going:

"Don't watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going."

You're improving, Akshat! Here's a motivational quote to help you keep going:

"Believe you can and you're halfway there."

You're getting closer to perfect posture, Akshat! Here's a motivational quote to keep you motivated:

"You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great."

Keep working on it, Akshat! Here's a motivational quote for good posture:

"Stand tall, not for the sake of others, but for your own strength."

You're making progress, Akshat! Here's a motivational quote for good posture:

"Straighten your posture, and your confidence will too."

You've got this, Akshat! Here's a motivational quote to help you improve your posture:

"Every step forward is a step up."

Keep working on it, Akshat! Try to sit or stand up straight with your shoulders relaxed and down, and your ears in line with your shoulders. Remember, good posture is a habit that gets stronger with practice!
You're on the right track, Akshat! Keep remembering to stretch your shoulders back and down, and relax your neck and shoulders, and you'll be standing taller in no time!
You're almost there, Akshat! "A little correction now makes a big difference later." Keep working at it!
You've got a lot of work to do, Akshat! Time to "Straighten up and turn it around!"
Time to "Stand up to the challenge!" Keep working on that posture!
It's time to "Straighten up, seriously!" Good posture is a habit, not a choice, so make it a habit! Stand up straight now!
You're really close, Akshat! Here's a motivational quote to keep you going: "Almost there, don't let the slack creep in now!"
Keep pushing, Akshat! "Stand tall, not for a few, but for all!"
Time to "Balance the books, balance your back!"
You're perfect, Akshat! "Keep standing tall, you've got it nailed!"
Good effort, Akshat! "Sit right, stay tight, strong all day!"
Not bad, but not great either, Akshat! However, sitting 3 out of 10 times slouching is a sign of slouching too much. Time to "Sit up straight, no more slouching around!"
Don't slouch, Akshat! "Straighten up, this is not a couch!"
What's going on, Akshat?! You're practically comatose! "Sit up, straight up! Your back will thank you, or hurt you!" Get a straight back, now!
Get back on track, Akshat! You're 40% right, but 40% wrong. You need to "Sit straight, or your back will cry!"
Almost perfect, Akshat! You're 90% straight, and 10% slouching. Fix that last 10%, and you'll be "Pain-free, and stress-free, at last!"
